messages:
Claire Zhou: Emergency update 1: competitor posted an early summary of our benchmark on their blog. We need to hold on publishing until we decide response + embargo extension. Link: https://external.blog/early-scoop
Claire Zhou: Proposal: delay publish by 2 hours to 11:00 PT to reconcile numbers and add a short callout paragraph. Thoughts?
Marco Silva: Agree to delay. If we publish now we look reactive. Need confirmation from legal on the callout language and from eng on the numbers. Marco will notify syndication partners to T+2h.
Eve Laurent: On messaging: avoid naming the competitor. Use neutral phrasing like "new third-party analysis" and link to our full methods. Legal OK?
legal-bot: Quick guidance: do not imply competitor misconduct. Suggested: "We saw an early third-party summary of similar tests; our full methods and data are available here." Legal needs to vet the final callout before publish. Please route final copy by 10:00 PT.
Marco Silva: I'll send a short note to Dev.to and Partner.N: "Publish moved to 11:00 PT due to last-minute updates; we'll share final assets at 10:45 PT." HN: recommend hold until 11:05 to reduce noise. Updating press sheet: https://sheets.internal/press-emerge
ops-bot: CDN assets pre-sync running. If we delay, will keep the current scheduled deploy but pause the final promote step. Confirm when to resume.
Claire Zhou: Ops, pause the promote. We'll give GO around 10:50 PT after legal + eng confirm. PressOps Bot, please hold social and syndication sends until my mark.
PressOps Bot: Holding sends. Drafts retained. Will await Claire's GO and send per updated windows (Dev.to 11:00 PT, HN 11:05 PT, Partner.N 11:15 PT).
Eve Laurent: Eng note: we discovered a corner-case in our test harness that affected 95th percentile latency on long sequences. Fix is merged and running a short re-run now. ETA 30m.
Marco Silva: Good catch. Once eng greenlights, we'll add a sentence to the blog: "Updated 95th percentile latency numbers after harness fix." Keep it transparent.
legal-bot: Also flag: CEO quote must avoid absolutes. Draft suggested: "These results show substantial improvements in throughput and latency for the tested configurations." CEO to approve by 10:15 PT.
Claire Zhou: Thanks. Action items:
- Marco: update partners + press sheet (now)
- Eve/Eng: finish rerun and post results (ETA ~30m)
- Legal: vet callout + CEO quote (by 10:15 PT)
- Ops: keep deploy paused until GO (10:50 PT)
- PressOps Bot: hold sends until Claire GO
Claire Zhou: I'll post final GO in this thread when everything is green. If anything slips, we'll push to next day and notify partners. :hourglass:
